## Visualizing Statistical Models

- We've spent most of the semester so far talking about visualizing data.
- But we often fit models to data, and communicating the results of our modeling is also an important topic in visualization.
- These next two lectures/code demos are not meant to teach you statistical modeling, *per se*, but rather some considerations in visualizing your models.

## Visualizing Statistical Models

#### Topics to Cover

- Randomness
  - Random variables
  - Signal vs. noise
- Mathematical models vs. statistical models
- Parameter estimates
- Model "predictions"
- Multivariate methods
  - Covariance
